name: Native Self-Training & Autonomous Evolution Engine
purpose: Pure Rust backpropagation, AdamW optimization, continual learning degradation control (EWC), candidate evaluation, dual-track Neural and World Model updating, and isolated model promotion.
registration: AbilityEngine coordinates self-training, self-update, practice, and rollback lifecycle; manual_trainer::main executes manual training workspace runs; NativeSelfTrainer::new initializes optimizer states; ContinualLearningGovernor::register_task; CodeEvolutionEngine::new initializes source-level evolution with creator authority gate.
discovery: ContinualLearningGovernor::select_priority_samples discovers high-loss training records; manual_trainer discovers canonical shards via config.json.
execution: NativeSelfTrainer::train_step computes loss and backpropagates gradients; train_candidate::main; manual_trainer::main; CodeEvolutionEngine::add_source_function adds source code under evolution gate.
storage: manual_training/ (config, checkpoints, runs, logs), storage/models/auto_candidate/ (neural, world_model), storage/models/tara/ (production), storage/training/self_trainer_status.json.
memory_link: High-value episodic lessons distilled directly into staged training samples.
learning_link: Continuous evolution loop updates model capabilities without catastrophic forgetting.
self_evolution_link: Candidate models evaluated on benchmark gates before dynamic promotion to production. CodeEvolutionEngine gates all source modifications through creator authority verification.
curriculum_link: Samples sampled according to 15-tier educational curriculum ladder.
safety_gates: Gradient norm clipping prevents exploding gradients
Elastic Weight Consolidation (EWC) penalty blocks catastrophic forgetting of core knowledge
Candidate models isolated in staging dir (manual_training/checkpoints/ or storage/models/auto_candidate/) until rigorous evaluation pass succeeds
UniversalRuntimeGate must approve before any model promotion
CodeEvolutionEngine requires creator authority verification before source modification
No self-promotion without benchmark gate pass — one failed benchmark = full reject
Zero direct overwriting of production weights or world state without verified promotion

lifecycle.1_dataset: StreamingDatasetReader streams canonical shards directly into training batches
lifecycle.2_train: NativeSelfTrainer::train_step — forward + cross-entropy loss + EWC penalty + backward + AdamW
lifecycle.3_checkpoint: Save candidate SafeTensors checkpoint into isolated directory (manual_training/checkpoints/neural/ or storage/models/auto_candidate/neural/)
lifecycle.4_world_model: WorldStateTracker snapshots candidate world state to isolated directory (manual_training/checkpoints/world_model/ or storage/models/auto_candidate/world_model/)
lifecycle.5_evaluate: SkillsEvaluator evaluates candidate on benchmark suite with regression check
lifecycle.6_gate: UniversalRuntimeGate & Creator authority verification gates promotion
lifecycle.7_promote: Atomic promotion to storage/models/tara/ and storage/persistence/world_model_state.json with dynamic HMAC/SHA seal
lifecycle.8_reload: TaraBrain hot-reloads promoted weights with zero downtime
